new_findings.title: Inline lease expiry can reclaim a live processor
new_findings.defect: The 30-minute reclaim clock is `IdentityScanJob.started_at`; the inline processor runs outside the dispatch transaction and does not heartbeat that timestamp after startup.
new_findings.failure_scenario: With inline mode enabled, 61 slow media items each taking near the detector's 30-second per-image timeout can keep the first processor active past 30 minutes. A same-key replay then sees RUNNING as stale and starts the full inline processor again, duplicating remote detection and persistence work.
new_findings.fix: Persist and renew a processor heartbeat while inline work runs, and reclaim only after heartbeat expiry with an owner/fencing check; alternatively enforce a verified maximum task duration below the lease.
